integrity: The analytical proof specifies all quantifiers and critical lemmas; standalone finite exact checks are supplementary and are not a certificate of infinite convergence.
scientific_limitations: Requires independent static coefficient bits with a uniform ellipticity constant and fair driving signs; no dependent environments, convergence rates, or asymmetric steps are addressed. Broad older Boolean-product strong laws may bear on historical priority.
title: Quenched Brownian normality for static cardinality-driven bootstrap walks
